name: com.apple.domains
title: Domains
description: The payload that configures the domains under an organization's management.

payload.content: This payload defines web domains that are under an enterprise's management.

payloadkeys.title: Email domains
payloadkeys.content: An array of domains. Mail marks in red all email addresses that lack a suffix matching any of these strings.

payloadkeys.title: Web domains
payloadkeys.content: An array of domains. The system considers URLs matching the patterns listed in this property managed.

payloadkeys.title: Password autofill domains
payloadkeys.content:
An array of domains. Users can only save passwords in Safari from URLs matching the patterns listed here. This property doesn't disable the autofill feature itself.

Supervised devices or Shared iPad need this property to enable saving passwords in Safari.

payloadkeys.title: Cross-site tracking prevention relaxed domains
payloadkeys.content: An array of up to 10 strings. URLs matching the patterns listed here have relaxed enforcement of cross-site tracking prevention.

payloadkeys.title: Cross-site tracking prevention relaxed apps
payloadkeys.content: An array of up to 10 strings representing app bundle-ids. Apps matching the bundle-ids listed here have relaxed enforcement of cross-site tracking prevention for the domains listed in `CrossSiteTrackingPreventionRelaxedDomains`.
